ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud investigations in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud
questions: How much money is involved in the Medicaid fraud?
Who are the key players involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and analyzing public records, we can get to the bottom of this story.
